paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak Ruba ('entered to bathe'), with Rabbi, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Kirah, halakhah 3. (See above, R. Yitzḥak bar Avdimi.) In Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter Ein Omedin, mishnah 2: R. Yitzḥak Rabbah, in Rabbi's name. R. Abba bar Yaakov, in his name (see above, Zuga). In Resh Lakish's name, Terumot, chapter 10, halakhah 10. In Bereshit Rabbah, at the printed locator ס״ע כ׳ [interpretation unresolved]: Yitzḥak Ravya.
